notes: Companion extension 1.0.6 removes MessageSender metadata from UI routing entirely. Pair now, Get status, Unpair, and Test bridge are private internal message types and now enter the UI path directly; YouTube content messages use separate types. A new executable harness imports the real background.js module with a Chrome MV3 mock and verifies that a tabbed Pair request with missing optional sender fields receives {ok:true} synchronously. This release includes chat-youtube-companion-1.0.6.zip and removes superseded 1.0.5. Remove the old extension, load 1.0.6 from a new folder, generate a fresh token, and pair again.
